exercises.title: Loại kỳ nghỉ (G&V Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Hoàn thành câu bằng: a city break, a beach holiday, a family holiday, a language exchange, an adventure holiday.

items.prompt: You can do lots of activities like cycling and horse-riding on ____.
My friends want to go on ____, but I don't enjoy relaxing all the time.
I went on ____ to Paris. It was interesting to visit all the museums.
My sister is going on ____ and will stay with a host family in Italy.

exercises.title: Từ khoá của từng người
exercises.instruction: Đọc mô tả về mỗi người và chọn YÊU CẦU QUAN TRỌNG NHẤT của họ.

items.prompt: Tom (19) is very active… He has done a lot of water sports… he would like to try something different… He went to the beach last year, but got bored.

options.text: muốn thể thao trên cạn mới lạ, năng động

items.explanation: Tom năng động, muốn thử điều KHÁC thể thao dưới nước, chán biển → Adventure Holidays (D).

items.prompt: Julia (16)… Their parents will not allow their daughters to be in another country without any adults… They both study Spanish.

options.text: đi một mình ra nước ngoài
có người lớn chăm sóc + luyện tiếng Tây Ban Nha

items.explanation: → Language Exchange (F): ở với host family (có người lớn), luyện ngôn ngữ, khám phá châu Âu.

items.prompt: Charlie (21)… prefers holidays in the countryside… would like to get a job working with animals in the future.

options.text: làm việc với động vật / nông thôn

items.prompt: Joanna (32)… very tired after a busy term… somewhere hot and near the sea. She wants to relax and not do very much.

exercises.title: Sửa động từ sai trong tóm tắt (Ex. 15)
exercises.instruction: Bản tóm tắt về Anna có 6 động từ sai thì. Viết dạng đúng (nếu đúng rồi, chép lại).

items.prompt: Anna ____ (1: study) French and Spanish at school at the moment.
items.explanation: at the moment + thói quen hiện tại, she → studies.

items.prompt: Last summer, she ____ (2: goes) to Spain on a language exchange…
…where she ____ (3: stayed) with a family in a village.
Anna now ____ (4: thought) that the language exchange programme…
…____ (5: was) a good experience for her…
…although she ____ (6: wasn't) much better at Spanish now than before.

exercises.title: Hội thoại về kỳ nghỉ (G&V Ex. 5)
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: A: ____ going on holiday?
B: Yes, ____. I always have a great time on holiday with my family.
A: I do, too. Where ____?
B: Usually we go on a beach holiday but last summer we ____ on a city break.
A: What ____ there?
B: Because my parents ____ going to the theatre, we all went to see a play.
A: ____ good?
A: I ____ plays. I think they are boring.
B: I thought that, too, but this one ____ boring at all.

exercises.title: Email của Sarah (G&V Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở hiện tại đơn hoặc quá khứ đơn.

items.prompt: I ____ (go) to Germany with my family last February.
My family and I ____ (not like) beach holidays, so we ____ (decide) to go to Berlin for a weekend.
Usually on holiday, I ____ (enjoy) visiting lots of famous museums but we ____ (not have) time to see everything.
So we just ____ (see) the main ones, like the Berlin Wall. In my opinion, they ____ (be) both very interesting monuments.
I ____ (learn) about them at school last year. We ____ (feel) cold because it ____ (be) the middle of winter.

exercises.title: Đọc nhanh email của Simon (Ex. 16)
exercises.instruction: Đọc nhanh email trong 2 phút và trả lời.

stimulus.text:
Hi Tony,

I went to Madrid for my last holiday – it was great! On the first day, I visited some of the famous sights here including the Prado museum and the Royal Palace. It is different to my usual holidays. Normally, I go to hot places and relax on the beach. At the moment, it's the opposite and it is quite cold here. On my second day, I went shopping and bought some souvenirs. That night it was really interesting because I ate in a Spanish restaurant. I usually don't try new food when I go on holiday, but I am very happy that I did this time. I tried a traditional meal of soup, vegetables and meat. It was delicious. It was only a short holiday, but I really enjoyed it. I took lots of photos. What did you do on your holiday? Where did you go?

Simon
stimulus.caption: Email from Simon

items.prompt: Where did Simon go?
Why was this holiday different to his trips before?

options.text: It was a city break and the weather was cold; normally he goes on beach holidays in warm weather.
He went with his family for the first time.
He stayed with a host family.

exercises.title: Email của Simon có gì? (Ex. 18)
exercises.instruction: Đặc điểm nào CÓ trong email của Simon, đặc điểm nào KHÔNG?

items.text: He uses a greeting to start the email.
He says where he went on holiday.
He says how he travelled there.
He says how long he stayed.
He says what he did on holiday.
He says what he usually does on holiday.
He asks about his friend's last holiday.
He asks about his friend's next holiday.
He finishes with his name at the end.

exercises.title: Viết email kể về kỳ nghỉ (Ex. 19)
exercises.instruction: Bạn của bạn, Hannah, muốn biết về kỳ nghỉ gần nhất của bạn: bạn đã đi đâu và làm gì. Viết email cho Hannah (150–175 từ). Trong email: (1) nói bạn đã đi đâu; (2) kể bạn đã làm gì ở đó; (3) hỏi Hannah về kỳ nghỉ gần nhất của bạn ấy.

checklist: Lời chào (Hi Hannah,) và tên ở cuối
Kể đã làm gì (theo ngày/thứ tự)
Hỏi Hannah về kỳ nghỉ của bạn ấy
Dùng đúng quá khứ đơn (động từ bất quy tắc)
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Hi Hannah,

Thanks for your email. I went to Da Nang with my family last summer and it was fantastic! We stayed in a small hotel near My Khe beach for five days.

On the first day, we swam in the sea and relaxed on the beach. The water was warm and very clean. On the second day, we went on a day trip to Hoi An. We walked around the old town, saw lots of beautiful old buildings and took hundreds of photos. In the evening, the streets were full of colourful lanterns. I usually don't like trying new food, but I tried cao lau, a traditional noodle dish, and it was delicious! On the last day, we visited the Marble Mountains and climbed to the top. It was hot and tiring, but the view was amazing.

I really enjoyed the holiday and I want to go back next year. What about you? Where did you go on your last holiday and what did you do there?

Write soon,
Minh
commonErrors: Dùng hiện tại cho việc đã qua (I go to Da Nang last summer)
Sai động từ bất quy tắc (buyed, eated, taked)

exercises.title: Vì sao C là đáp án đúng? (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Đọc Part 1 và trả lời.

stimulus.text: Well, students can travel to France or Spain on a language exchange, or to the USA on a sports or music exchange. I didn't go to the USA because I'm not very good at sports. However, I study French and Spanish at school, so I had two options. I've been to France before, so I decided to go to Spain instead.
stimulus.caption: Part 1 (tr. 51)

items.prompt: Why did Anna decide to go on a language exchange programme in Spain?

options.text: She studies Spanish and not French.
She wanted to go somewhere new.

items.explanation: "I've been to France before, so I decided to go to Spain instead." A sai (không giỏi thể thao); B sai (học CẢ tiếng Pháp và Tây Ban Nha).

exercises.title: As, so hay because? (Ex. 11, G&V Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Chọn từ nối đúng.

items.prompt: I didn't go on the language exchange ____ my language level wasn't high enough.
____ we enjoy kayaking, we decided to go on an adventure holiday this year.
items.explanation: As + lý do ở đầu câu.

items.prompt: The host family spoke English really well ____ I wasn't worried.
We prefer city breaks ____ we enjoy exploring new places.
____ my parents enjoy trying traditional food, they went on a food tour.

exercises.title: Nói: trả lời có lý do (Ex. 12)
exercises.instruction: Trả lời từng câu hỏi trong 20–30 giây, dùng as / so / because để giải thích.

items.prompt: If you were on a language exchange, would you like to stay with a host family or in a hotel? Why?
items.sampleAnswer: I would definitely prefer a host family, because I could practise speaking English every day. As they know the area well, they could also show me interesting places that tourists don't usually see.
items.sampleNote: because + as, có hai lý do.

items.prompt: What do you like more – holidays with your friends or holidays with your family? Why?
items.sampleAnswer: I like holidays with my friends more because we like the same activities, so we never get bored. With my family, we usually just relax at the beach, which is nice but a bit boring for me.

items.prompt: What's better: a beach holiday or a city break? Why?
items.sampleAnswer: For me, a city break is better. As I love history and old buildings, I always want to visit museums. I get bored quickly on the beach, so I don't often choose beach holidays.

exercises.title: Nói: một chuyến đi bạn rất thích (Ex. 22–23)
exercises.instruction: Đọc đề, chuẩn bị 1 phút (ghi từ khoá), rồi nói 1–2 phút.

items.prompt:
Describe a trip you really liked.
You should say:
• where you went
• what you did on the trip
• why you went
and explain why you liked it so much.
items.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about a trip to Da Lat that I went on with my classmates last December. Da Lat is a city in the mountains in the south of Vietnam, and it's famous for its cool weather and flowers. We went there because it was the end of our school term and our teacher organised a trip to celebrate. We travelled by coach and the journey took about seven hours, so we sang songs and played games on the way. During the trip, we visited a beautiful flower garden, walked around Xuan Huong Lake and went to the night market, where I tried grilled rice paper for the first time. It was delicious! On the second day, we got up very early to watch the sunrise from a hill, and that was amazing. I liked this trip so much because I spent time with my best friends without our parents for the first time, so I felt very free and grown-up. Also, as the weather in my city is always hot, it was really nice to wear a jacket and feel cold. I'll never forget it.
items.sampleNote: Đi đủ 4 ý trên thẻ theo thứ tự; nhiều chi tiết (thời gian, ai, phương tiện, món ăn); dùng because / so / as cho phần giải thích.
